name: proven-slot
spec: op-private-interop/docs/DESIGN.md: the claim is an ordinary L2 transaction, and it leads the range it describes.
description: Well-formed bytes carrying a 65-byte proof slot (the bytes 0x00..0x40, a placeholder for a real proof; 65 is deliberately not a multiple of 32, so this also pins the ABI tail padding). ModeProven decodes it; ModeAttested REFUSES it, which is the standing v1 rule: a verifier with no proof system must not accept a claim whose central claim it is not equipped to evaluate.
